skills.label: Refresh Daily Report
skills.description: Rebuilds the dashboard report: tasks, today's shoots, pipeline, invoices, IG stats.
skills.prompt:
Generate the daily report as strict JSON. Gather:
1) Read TASKS.md at the workspace root. Count open tasks by priority (High/Medium/Low sections). Pick the 5 most urgent open items as 'top'. From '## Recently Completed', list items dated within the last 2 days as yesterdayCompleted.
2) the CRM (gohighlevel MCP): today's events on the production-days calendar (id from config: PRODUCTION_CALENDAR_ID). Open opportunities in the the New Client pipeline (id from config: SALES_PIPELINE_ID): total open value and per-stage counts/values. Total value of opportunities Won this calendar month. Invoices with status sent or partially_paid whose due date has passed: count, total, and per-invoice who/amount/daysOverdue.
3) Instagram (meta MCP): follower count for the IG account, number of media posted in the last 30 days, and the recent post with the best engagement (caption excerpt + its best stat).
If any single source fails, keep going and set that section to null with a note in 'notes'.
Then output ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fences, no commentary) exactly in this shape:
{"todayCalendar":[{"time":"3:00 PM","title":"..."}],"yesterdayCompleted":["..."],"openTasks":{"high":0,"medium":0,"low":0,"top":["..."]},"pipeline":{"openValue":0,"wonThisMonth":0,"stages":[{"name":"...","count":0,"value":0}]},"invoices":{"overdueCount":0,"overdueTotal":0,"items":[{"who":"...","amount":0,"daysOverdue":0}]},"social":{"igFollowers":0,"posts30d":0,"top":{"caption":"...","stat":"..."}},"notes":["..."]}

skills.label: Pipeline Drift Check
skills.description: Compares project phases in TASKS.md against the CRM Production Pipeline stages and flags mismatches. Report only.
skills.prompt:
Run the pipeline drift check. Monday.com is NOT reachable from this CLI, so use TASKS.md as the phase source (say so in the output header).
1) Read TASKS.md and extract every project that has a stated production phase/status (editing, revisions, delivered, etc.).
2) Fetch open opportunities in the GHL the Production pipeline (id from config: PRODUCTION_PIPELINE_ID) and their stages, plus the New Client pipeline (id from config: SALES_PIPELINE_ID) statuses.
3) Compare using the phase-sync crosswalk documented in the workspace CLAUDE.md.
Output a markdown table: project | TASKS.md phase | GHL stage | verdict (OK / DRIFT) | recommended move. Do NOT change anything in GHL — report only.

skills.label: Task Triage
skills.description: Reads TASKS.md and flags stale items, at-risk delivery promises, and today's top 3. Report only.
skills.prompt:
Read TASKS.md and MEMORY.md at the workspace root. Produce a triage report:
1) Items that look stale (no movement implied for 14+ days) with a recommended next action each.
2) Delivery promises at risk (anything promised to a client that may be slipping — see Failure Pattern 5 in skills/11-failure-patterns.md).
3) Top 3 for today, with one line of reasoning each.
Report only — do not edit TASKS.md.

skills.label: Pipeline Review
skills.description: Full sales-pipeline health check: stalled deals, $0 Won deals, next best actions.
skills.prompt:
Review the sales pipeline. Fetch both pipelines (New Client = SALES_PIPELINE_ID, Production = PRODUCTION_PIPELINE_ID) and all open opportunities. Report:
1) Every open opp: name, stage, value, how stale it looks.
2) Stalled deals (no movement 21+ days) with a next best action each.
3) Any Won deals at $0 value — revenue invisible in the source of truth.
4) Totals vs the pacing targets recorded in MEMORY.md.
Report only — change nothing.
